build.title: Theme veto pass: timed no-veto window for token changes

said.text: a timed pass ("allow theme changes for the next 30 minutes") during which token set/reset runs without the axHub veto. Grant approved once by Brett; server-side expiry; deletes never covered; banner chip with countdown; audit + undo; read tools annotated read-only; contract with axHub build axhub-veto-pass. Based on PR #250 (merge after it).

steps.text: control@1 pass resource: grant/status/revoke/list/undo, scopes tokens.theme|style|layout|*, minutes 1-240, one pass per scope, deletes never covered
Grant needs owner approval once (model-upgrade-approval pattern); covered set/reset skip veto until server-side expiry
Expose in REST, MCP (token_pass_*) and CLI (axf token pass …) with plain-language answers
Banner chip with live countdown (revoke/extend), 2-minute warning, audit + THREADS line per grant and change, pass.undo
Read-only annotations on every read tool + recommended axHub policy doc
axHub contract: signed GET /pass, scope stamp per call (docs for axhub-veto-pass)
Help pack, tests, theme/controls checks, lifecycle, report, THREADS, PR after #250

uiReview.name: Token pass banner chip + Token control Passes tab

open: axHub side (`axhub-veto-pass`, axHub repo) still has to read `GET pass`, skip covered calls and forward Brett's approval with the signature; until it lands, a pass shows and logs but axHub still vetoes every call.
A shell on the VPS can always write files directly; the pass guards the API, MCP and CLI surfaces, not the disk.
Undo writes the before-values even if someone changed the same token outside the pass afterwards (last write wins, as everywhere).
Kotlin twin deferred (Android on hold); recorded with the control@1 gap.
